incident-bot: [ALERT] Prefill GPU OOM detected on cluster us-west1-gpu-pool node gpu-23 — container restart loop (3 restarts in 5m). Auto-paging @oncall :pager:

jessica_sre: taking this, summoning @lee_oncall. initial hypothesis: long-conversation prefill growth on shard-3 causing KV cache blowup.

lee_oncall: oncall here. I muted the noisy test traffic for shard-3 and enabled cold-model fallback for affected routes. Any quick numbers?

amir_eng: logs show repeated cuda OOM during prefill phase for windows >120k tokens. model=open-lama-70b-qat host=shard-3

```
E cuda: out of memory when allocating 4.2G
prefill: token_count=134217
kvcache_size=3.8GB
stack: runtime/prefill
```

maya_support: customer impact: two enterprise accounts in us-west1 reported streaming timeouts & partial responses ~09:04-09:08. tickets created.

jessica_sre: mitigation plan (live): 1) enable prefill-trim policy to cap context at 100k tokens 2) route traffic away from shard-3 to shard-5 + cold fallback 3) cordon/drain node gpu-23 for safe repro & restart. applying now.

carlos_prod: flipping feature-flag prefill_trim=100000 on prod-route v4 (rolling update).

lee_oncall: traffic reroute completed, cold fallback active. monitoring metrics (latency/errors).

amir_eng: prepping hotfix to reduce KV prefetch and lower batch_kv -> 8 to limit per-request mem. will push canary to shard-5 first.

jessica_sre: executing drain: `kubectl cordon node/gpu-23` then `kubectl drain node/gpu-23 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — evicting pods.

ops_bot: node/gpu-23 cordoned. Pods evicted: 4. New pods scheduled on shard-5 pool.

maya_support: customer comms: "We've temporarily routed requests to a fallback model to avoid timeouts. We're monitoring and will provide an update in 30 minutes."

lee_oncall: quick health: error-rate us-west1 dropped 12% -> 1.5% after reroute. No new container restarts in last 5m.

amir_eng: deploying hotfix to kvcache trimming now to reduce memory footprint. estimate 20m to full rollout; will monitor canary.

jessica_sre: incident severity set to sev3. Postmortem owner: @amir_eng. Next steps: root-cause triage, add prefill safety checks, refine canary thresholds. If stable in 15m we plan to close the active pager.

carlos_prod: scaling cold model capacity in us-west1 by +2 nodes to handle spillover.

maya_support: adding note to the two affected tickets with mitigation details & ETA.

lee_oncall: status check @09:25 — system stable, metrics steady. Will keep monitoring; update in 30m or sooner if regressions. last_message_ts 7843219645
